scripts.build: pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/sdk build && pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/demo build && pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/relayer build && pnpm build:evm
scripts.build:vercel: pnpm build:official-bridge && pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/sdk build && pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/demo build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/sdk build && pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/demo typecheck && pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/relayer typecheck && pnpm typecheck:vercel
